title: Pure Aquaactress
summary: Aquaactress is a WATER Aqua archetype that combines small monsters with the 'Aquarium' Continuous Spells to achieve battle immunity, double stats, and floating recursion. Swap Frog and Wetlands supercharge their offensive output, turning Level 1 Tetra and Level 2 Guppy into 4000+ ATK beatsticks.

allow.Swap Frog: Sends Aquaactress monsters to the GY to be revived by Aquarium Lighting/Stage and provides extra Aqua summons.
allow.Wetlands: Field Spell that gives all Level 2 or lower Aqua WATER monsters 1200 ATK, which is then doubled by Aquarium Lighting.
allow.Surface: Revives Level 3 or lower Aqua monsters like Tetra or Guppy in Defense Position to trigger their effects.
allow.Moray of Greed: Shuffles 2 WATER monsters from hand into the Deck to draw 3 cards.
allow.Toadally Awesome: Rank 2 Aqua Xyz boss accessible via Guppy and Swap Frog that provides omni-negation and recycles WATER monsters.
allow.Mistar Boy: Link-2 WATER monster that boosts all WATER monsters' ATK by 500 and recycles from GY upon destruction.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives any Aquaactress from the GY.

main: Aquaactress Tetra
Core starter that searches any Aquarium Continuous Spell from the Deck once per turn.
Aquaactress Guppy
Special Summons an Aquaactress monster from the hand once per turn to swarm the board.
Aquaactress Arowana
Level 6 beater that searches an Aquaactress monster from the Deck once per turn.
Swap Frog
Dumps Arowana or Tetra to the GY so destroyed Aquarium Spells can immediately revive them.
Aquarium Stage
Continuous Spell that makes WATER monsters immune to battle destruction by non-WATER monsters and floats into an Aqua monster.
Aquarium Set
Continuous Spell that boosts WATER monsters by 300 ATK/DEF and Aquaactress monsters by an extra 300, floating into an Aqua on destruction.
Aquarium Lighting
Continuous Spell that doubles the ATK and DEF of battling Aquaactress monsters during damage calculation.
Wetlands
Boosts Tetra and Guppy by 1200 ATK before Aquarium Lighting doubles their stats.
Surface
Special Summons Tetra or Guppy from the GY to immediately search or extend.
Moray of Greed
Fixes hands by shuffling excess WATER monsters back to draw 3 cards.
extra: Summoned using two Level 2 Aqua monsters (Guppy/Swap Frog) for omni-negation and WATER recursion.
Revives Tetra or Guppy from the GY to trigger their effects again.
